text: DIAGNOSIS READY: Pelvic Inflammatory Disease (PID). The clinical presentation of sudden lower abdominal pain in a sexually active patient who denies urinary or gastrointestinal symptoms is highly suggestive of an upper genital tract infection. Given the negative urinalysis and lack of fever, a ruptured ectopic pregnancy or appendicitis are less likely, but the high risk of PID necessitates immediate empiric treatment with broad-spectrum antibiotics covering Neisseria gonorrhoeae and Chlamydia trachomatis.
